tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// tshad ma smra ba'i don 'grel zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang po nyer zhi zhi ba'i lam ston cing*// kun sbyor 'ching ba ma lus gcod mdzad pa// thugs rje me tog dkar po rgyas pa yi// bde gshegs lam la gus pas 'dud par bgyi// gsung rab kun gyi snying po'i don bsdus pa// lam gyi rim pa tshang la ma nor zhing*// rgyal sras kun gyi 'jug yul rmad byung ba// rnam par phye ste rab tu bshad par bya// de la 'dir gsung rab thams cad kyi snying po'i don bsdus pa bka' 'khor lo bzhi yi don bshad par bya'o/ 'khor lo bzhi gang zhe na/ lta ba yas phub/ spyod pa mas 'dzeg gzhi snying rje chen po/ thabs pha rol du phyin pa bcu'o// dang po ni/ theg pa dman pa'i lta ba las 'das pa/ lta ba thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis gsungs pa'i dbu ma'i lta ba dgos par bstan no// de yang stong pa nyid ston pa'i mdo mtha' dag dang*/ bye brag tu stong nyid bco brgyad bstan pa las shes par bya'o// spyod pa mas 'dzeg ces pa ni/ mi dge ba bcu spong zhing*/ dge ba bcu bsgrub pa la bya ste/ srog gcod spong ba dang*/ ma byin len spong ba dang*/ mi tshangs spyod spong bas ni lus 'dul bar byed do// rdzun/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag 'khyal bzhi spong bas ni ngag 'dul bar byed do// rnab sems dang*/ gnod sems dang*/ log lta spong bas ni yid 'dul bar byed do// gang zag gcig la lus ngag yid gsum las med la/ de ni 'di dag gis 'dul bar byed pas/ 'dul ba'i gnad kun tu 'dus so// mi dge ba bcu'i gnyen po ni/ dge ba bcus byed do/ gzhi snying rje chen po ni/ snying rje tsam ni theg dman la'ang yod la/ 'dir ni nam mkhas khyab tshad kyi sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i snying rje chen po ste/ snying rje chen po dgos par bstan no// lta ba yas phub ces pa dang*/

gzhi snying rje chen po zhes pas ni/ nyams len gyi gnad stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can du 'dus par bstan no// thabs pha rol tu phyin pa bcu zhes pa la/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu ni sa bcu yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs te/ theg pa chen po'i chos mtha' dag 'dir 'dus so// lta ba dang*/ sgom pa dang*/ spyod pa gsum ka'ang 'dir 'dus te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni lta ba yin la/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni sgom pa yin no// tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang*/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni sems kyi bslab pa dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas shes rab kyi bslab pa bsdus so// thabs dang shes rab gnyis kyang 'dir 'du ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang po lnga ni thabs yin la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shes rab kyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro// tshogs gnyis kyang 'dir 'du ste/ sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang bzod pa gsum ni bsod nams kyi tshogs yin la/ bsam gtan dang shes rab gnyis ni ye shes kyi tshogs yin pa'i phyir dang*/ brtson 'grus ni gnyis kar bsdus so// zhi gnas dang lhag mthong yang 'dir 'du ste/ bsam gtan gyis zhi gnas dang*/ shes rab kyis lhag mthong bsdus pas so// sbyin sogs re re nas nyams su len pa'i cha ni thabs yin la/ sbyin sogs re re'ang 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas nyams su len pa ni shes rab yin no// yang zhi gnas dang lhag mthong bye brag tu bshad pa la/ zhi gnas ni bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ gzugs med bzhi/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug rnam par thar pa brgyad/ thar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu rnams kyis bsdus so// lhag mthong ni bdag med gnyis dang*/ rnam thar sgo gsum dang*/ stong nyid bco brgyad rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi cha rnams so// de yang chos can re re nas sgro 'dogs gcod dgos pa'i cha nas dbye ba yin gyi/

skabs don nye bar bsdus na bzhir 'du ste/ phyi stong pa nyid dang*/ nang stong pa nyid dang*/ gnyis ka stong pa nyid dang*/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid do// dang po gsum ni chos can la bden 'dzin gcod pa'i don du bstan la/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni/ chos nyid la bden 'dzin gcod pa'i don du yin no// chos can dang chos nyid du ma 'dus pa'i chos gzhan med pas de gnyis stong pa nyid du bstan pa na/ bdag med mtha' dag rtogs pas lhag mthong gi don yongs su rdzogs par 'grub bo// gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag /blo yi mdun na mi gnas pa// de tshe rnam pa gzhan med pas// dmigs pa med par rab tu zhi// zhes pa dang*/ snang bzhin du stong*/ stong bzhin du snang zhes pas bden gnyis dbyer med du rtogs dgos par bstan cing*/ gzugs stong pa'o// stong pa nyid gzugs so// zhes pas ni/ sgro 'dogs pa dang*/ skur pa 'debs pa'i mtha' gnyis bsal zhing*/ gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no// zhes gsungs pas/ snang stong dbyer med du rtogs par bya dgos par bstan no// phul du byung ba'i blo gros rab brnyes nas// gsung rab kun gyi snying po man ngag tu// legs par bsdus nas bshad pa'i dge ba des// 'gro kun bla med byang chub thob gyur cig /ces tshad ma smra ba'i don 'grel gsung rab thams cad kyi gnad bsdus nas nyams su len pa'i man ngag ces bya ba 'di ni rong ston chen po shes bya kun rig gis dpal nā lend+ra zhes bya ba'i dgon par rab byung gi lo sa ga'i zla ba la sbyar ba'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
